body:

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-124-mcp-integration-02-07-persist-mcp-tool-thr_baziju47de`.

## Summary

Implements issue #124: persistence for MCP tool registrations and per-project grants, building on #123's `mcpServers` item-model foundation.

- **Migration `0020_mcp_tool_registrations.sql`**: creates `mcp_tool_registrations` (server item id, tool name/schema/description snapshot, `active`, `requires_approval` default `true`, `risk_class` default `unclassified`, timestamps, unique `(mcp_server_item_id, tool_name)`) and `project_mcp_grants` (composite PK `(project_item_id, mcp_tool_registration_id)`, `granted` default `false`, FK to the registrations table).
- **`mcp/mcpToolRegistrationsStore.ts`**: reads, a sync-facing `upsertMcpToolRegistration` (for the future tool-discovery issue #125) that preserves user-owned `risk_class`/`requires_approval` across re-syncs, and user-only mutations `setMcpToolRiskClass`/`setMcpToolRequiresApproval`.
- **`mcp/mcpProjectGrantsStore.ts`**: reads and the user-only `setProjectMcpGrant` mutation. Neither table is wired into the item-model/proposal-confirmation machinery, so agents and proposal confirmation have no write path to grants.
- Updated `testSupport/testDb.ts` truncate list and `index.ts` exports; added integration tests for defaults, uniqueness, re-sync field preservation, and grant idempotency.

Verified: full backend suite (`pnpm run test` — unit, integration: 50 files/529 tests, e2e: 5 tests) passes with exit code 0, `tsc --noEmit` is clean, and `check:boundaries` (dependency-cruiser) reports no violations.

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-124-mcp-integration-02-07-persist-mcp-tool-thr_baziju47de` (existing PR #329).

## Summary

Implements issue #124: persistence for MCP tool registrations and per-project grants, building on #123's `mcpServers` item-model foundation.

- **Migration `0020_mcp_tool_registrations.sql`**: creates `mcp_tool_registrations` (server item id, tool name/schema/description snapshot, `active`, `requires_approval` default `true`, `risk_class` default `unclassified`, timestamps, unique `(mcp_server_item_id, tool_name)`) and `project_mcp_grants` (composite PK `(project_item_id, mcp_tool_registration_id)`, `granted` default `false`, FK to the registrations table).
- **`mcp/mcpToolRegistrationsStore.ts`**: reads and the sync-facing `upsertMcpToolRegistration` (for the future tool-discovery issue #125), which preserves user-owned `risk_class`/`requires_approval` across re-syncs and now rejects an explicit `undefined` tool schema with a clear `ValidationError`.
- **`mcp/mcpProjectGrantsStore.ts`**: reads only.
- **`mcp/mcpGrantsAdminStore.ts`** (new, added in response to code review): the three user-only mutations — `setProjectMcpGrant`, `setMcpToolRiskClass`, `setMcpToolRequiresApproval`. This module is deliberately not re-exported from the package's `index.ts`, and `@semprec/data`'s `package.json` `exports` field only exposes `.` and `./testSupport`, so with `NodeNext` module resolution a deep import from `agent-runtime` (which already depends on `@semprec/data`) fails at compile time — verified directly with a throwaway import. This makes "agents have no write path to grants" a mechanical guarantee rather than just a comment.
- Updated tests to match; added a duplicate-key test, a re-sync field-preservation test, and a new `undefined` tool-schema validation test.

Verified: full backend suite (`pnpm run test` — unit: 83 tests, integration: 50 files/530 tests, e2e: 5 tests) passes with exit code 0, `tsc --noEmit` is clean, and `check:boundaries` (dependency-cruiser) reports no violations.
